snippet.title: Grey Verge — Elite Enemy Battle | A Roguelite Deckbuilder with Unique Combat Mechanics
snippet.description:
Free demo coming to Steam in October 2026:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4984240/?utm_source=yt_en_combat

Grey Verge is a fast-paced roguelite deckbuilder where you chain cards of the same color or character to unleash powerful combos.

Equip powerful Marks that reshape how your cards behave, discover new synergies, and lead three Vergewalkers into the strange realm that suddenly emerged between light and darkness.

#GreyVerge #roguelite  #deckbuilder
